component.name: Trad Desktop
component.summary: Native desktop widgets, suites, weather, music players, and audio visualizers

description.p: Trad Desktop brings hardware-accelerated desktop widgets and suites natively to Linux (Wayland and X11/XWayland, including GNOME, KDE Plasma, Pop!_OS COSMIC, Hyprland, and Cinnamon) and Windows.

ul.li: Full-screen Suites (TradSunset, Trad Cyber, DashboardSuite, GreenRibbonSuite) with automatic monitor resolution fitting
8 Modular Basic Telemetry Widgets with 10 Color Themes, 6 Card Shapes, and 4 Gauge Designs
3 MPRIS2 Media Players (Spotify, Browser, VLC, Rhythmbox) and 2 Real-Time 20-Band PipeWire/PulseAudio Spectrum Visualizers
Clickable Live Weather Forecast with 24-hour temperature curve, 7-day forecast, and global city + rural village search

description.p: Rebranded to Trad Desktop with pinned desktop widgets, live expandable weather forecast with rural village geocoding, 6 widget shapes, 4 gauge designs, music players, 20-band audio visualizers, APT .deb installer, Flatpak bundle, and Windows standalone .exe.
